name: Exp_LaguerreFilter
summary: This EA trades based on the Laguerre Filter indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator's signal line crosses above the filter line and sell positions when it crosses below. It uses a custom LaguerreFilter indicator with a gamma parameter to control smoothing, and includes configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and position sizing. The strategy is a trend-following system that enters on crossover signals and exits on reverse crossovers or SL/TP.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Laguerre滤波器指标进行交易，当信号线上穿滤波线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓。它使用自定义LaguerreFilter指标，通过gamma参数控制平滑程度，并包含可配置的止损、止盈和仓位管理。该策略属于趋势跟踪系统，在交叉信号时入场，在反向交叉或止损止盈时出场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Laguerre滤波器指标作为核心策略，利用其两条线（信号线和滤波线）的交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当信号线从下方穿越滤波线上方时开多仓，当信号线从上方穿越滤波线下方时开空仓，使用SignalBar参数指定信号确认的K线位置。出场条件包括反向交叉信号平仓以及固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金比例（默认0.1），并支持LOT和MARGIN两种仓位模式。资金管理方面，EA使用iCustom调用自定义指标，通过CopyBuffer获取指标数值，采用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的趋势跟踪交叉系统，但缺少加仓、减仓和移动止损等高级资金管理功能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Laguerre Filter indicator as its core strategy, utilizing crossovers between its two lines (signal line and filter line) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the signal line crosses above the filter line from below, and a sell position opens when the signal line crosses below the filter line from above, with the SignalBar parameter specifying the bar offset for signal confirmation. Exit conditions include closing on reverse crossover signals and fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points) levels. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) supporting both LOT and MARGIN modes for lot calculation. Money management relies on the custom LaguerreFilter indicator accessed via iCustom, with values retrieved through CopyBuffer, and an IsNewBar mechanism ensuring signals are calculated only once per bar to prevent duplicate trades. The overall strategy logic is clear and follows a typical trend-following crossover system, but lacks advanced money management features such as pyramiding, partial closes, or trailing stops.

pros: 使用Laguerre滤波器指标，该指标相比传统移动平均线具有更好的平滑性和更低的滞后性
采用IsNewBar机制防止同一K线内重复交易，逻辑严谨
提供买卖开关独立控制，灵活性好，可选择仅开仓或仅平仓
止损止盈参数可配置，风控基础框架完善
Recount机制在指标数据获取失败时自动重试，增强了鲁棒性
pros_en: Uses Laguerre Filter indicator which offers better smoothness and lower lag compared to traditional moving averages
Implements IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar, ensuring logical rigor
Provides independent buy/sell switches for flexible control, allowing open-only or close-only configurations
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide a solid risk management framework
Recount mechanism automatically retries when indicator data retrieval fails, improving robustness
cons: 缺少移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，在趋势行情中无法锁定浮动利润
止损1000点、止盈2000点的固定比例可能不适合所有市场环境，缺少动态调整机制
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下交叉信号可能产生虚假交易
缺少多时间周期确认，单一指标信号容易受震荡行情干扰产生频繁交易
依赖外部自定义指标LaguerreFilter，如果指标文件缺失则EA无法初始化
cons_en: Lacks trailing stop functionality, unable to lock in floating profits during trending markets
Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP may not suit all market conditions, lacking dynamic adjustment
No spread filter, crossover signals may produce false trades in high-spread environments
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, single indicator signals are prone to frequent whipsaw trades in ranging markets
Depends on external custom indicator LaguerreFilter; if the indicator file is missing, EA initialization fails
improvements: 增加移动止损功能，在趋势行情中动态跟踪利润，提高盈亏比
添加点差过滤和多时间周期确认机制，减少虚假信号和频繁交易
improvements_en: Add trailing stop functionality to dynamically track profits during trending markets and improve risk-reward ratio
Add spread filter and multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism to reduce false signals and over-trading

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下可能频繁触发虚假交叉信号导致亏损
固定止损止盈不适应所有波动环境，低波动时止损过大，高波动时止盈不够
单指标交叉策略在震荡行情中容易产生连续亏损信号
risk_points_en: No spread filter may cause frequent false crossover signals in high-spread environments leading to losses
Fixed SL/TP does not adapt to all volatility conditions — SL too wide in low volatility, TP insufficient in high volatility
Single indicator crossover strategy is prone to consecutive losing signals in ranging markets
